name: PlayerMovementData
description: Configuration and runtime state for local player ground movement.

variables.name: move_speed
variables.description: World units per second for base ground movement.

variables.name: input_dead_zone
variables.description: Minimum Player/Move vector length before movement starts.

variables.name: rotate_to_move_direction
variables.description: When true, the player instantly faces the current movement direction.

variables.name: turn_speed
variables.description: Reserved turn speed in degrees per second for future smoothed rotation.

variables.name: current_input
variables.description: Latest accepted Player/Move input vector after dead-zone filtering.

variables.name: current_move_direction
variables.description: Normalized world-space movement direction on the XZ plane.

variables.name: is_moving
variables.description: True while the accepted input vector is outside the dead zone.
